svg.title: Paxos v1 lightweight transaction - Group 4
svg.text: Lightweight transaction (INSERT ... IF NOT EXISTS) = one Paxos v1 instance per partition
Message names copied from our Exp 6 traces (paxos_variant = v1, coordinator cass1). No leader: any coordinator can propose; ballots, not a stable leader, order competing proposals.
First LWT on a new handle. 4 round trips; trace duration 7.7 ms.
Every phase needs a majority (2 of 3); the coordinator is itself one of the acceptors.
A competing proposer with a higher ballot makes acceptors reject this one -> the loser retries;
in-flight proposals found in a promise are re-proposed first (repair).
Ordinary reads and writes never run these phases.
Same handle again. Trace: 'CAS precondition does not match'.
the empty proposal only closes this ballot
Every phase needs a majority (2 of 3); the coordinator is itself one of the acceptors.
Exp 6 race: 20 / 20 handles had exactly one winner; plain INSERTs at QUORUM acknowledged
all 200 writes and 180 were silently overwritten by last-write-wins.
Ordinary reads and writes never run these phases.
